name_english: Karma Sannyasa Yoga (The Yoga of Renunciation of Action)
summary_short: Krishna explains that true renunciation lies not in abandoning action, but in acting without attachment.
summary_medium: Arjuna asks whether renunciation or action is better. Krishna clarifies that both lead to liberation, but selfless action performed with wisdom is superior. The chapter describes the peace attained by one who sees all beings equally and acts without ego.
summary_detailed: Krishna reconciles Karma Yoga and renunciation.
He teaches that wise action is true renunciation.
Attachment, not action, is the cause of bondage.
The liberated person acts without ego or desire.
Equal vision toward all beings is emphasized.
The chapter highlights inner peace and freedom.
True happiness arises from within, not externally.
what_you_learn: Why action with wisdom leads to liberation.
How to live free while acting.
